Synthetic public OpenPGP fixtures generated with two explicitly authorized test-only Ed25519 keys in an offline disposable container on 2026-09-11. Private keys were not exported and were removed with that container. These keys are not production trust anchors. Real verification tests inject a fixed clock only through the test ProcessRunner so key expiry cannot make tests depend on wall time. Production verification has no clock override and must reject KEYEXPIRED/EXPKEYSIG even if GnuPG exits 0. No other application keyring is read.
